rationale: Ground truth is trivial (just an 'lgtm'), so both get full recall by default. Both independently surface the same real latent bug — pure-diffusion mode sets serving_tokenization=None but _create_speech_error_json_response still calls base(raw_request).create_error_response() unguarded — which is a strong, well-grounded shared finding. Y pads its review with three near-duplicate restatements of that same point across separate bullets, and its 'Merge blocker' finding on the CI failures is self-contradictory since Y's own evidence shows the PR is already MERGED; it also suggests reintroducing openai_serving_tokenization as a compat alias, which undoes the rename's purpose. X keeps findings tighter and non-redundant, proposes a single clean fix location, and explicitly hedges its more speculative follow-up (sibling renames) as unverified against the pinned vLLM version rather than asserting it.
